item.title: FTC Announces Revised HSR Act Thresholds and Increased Filing Fees
item.description: What Happened: The Federal Trade Commission published revised Hart-Scott-Rodino (HSR) thresholds and updated filing fees, and revised thresholds for interlocking directorates, for 2026. The new HSR thresholds and filing fees become effective on February 17, 2026. The Bottom Line: The new HSR thresholds are higher than current thresholds, and the new filing fees have been increased for all transactions. item.title: 2025 Insurance Year in Review
item.description: If recent years have taught insurance practitioners anything, it is that the most consequential coverage disputes rarely turn on novelty alone. In 2025, courts continued to resolve high‑stakes insurance disputes by returning to first principles—examining when claims are related, how losses and occurrences are defined and aggregated, and how policy language allocates risk across time and conduct. item.title: California Rolls Out New Venture Capital Diversity Reporting Requirements
item.description: Part I: Who Is Covered and When Must You Register/Report? item.description: On Jan. 29, 2026, President Donald J. item.title: Out in the Cold: Eddie Bauer Files for Chapter 11 Bankruptcy in New Jersey
item.description: Eddie Bauer LLC, the retail operator of approximately 180 Eddie Bauer stores across the U.S. and Canada, filed for voluntary Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection on February 9, 2026, in the United States Bankruptcy Court for the District of New Jersey under docket #26-11422-SLM. This marks the third bankruptcy filing for the iconic outdoor apparel brand in a little over two decades.
